###################################################### 
# 4. Update time formatting
###################################################### 
  
  # Pull the last set of numbers between _ and .wav under "File Offset (s)" column, e.g., 50000 from "/BIGM02_20240525_050000.wav". Convert to hours, so 50000 = 5:00:00 AM. Then add the seconds to the time from the "Begin Time (s)" column, e.g., 239287.960 to make a column called "Time Detected"	
  
final_data2 <- final_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Step 1: Extract raw time from filename
    raw_time = str_extract(`Begin Path`, "(?<=_)\\d+(?=\\.wav)"),

    # Step 1a: If raw_time has only 4 digits, add a trailing 0
    raw_time = if_else(str_length(raw_time) == 4,
                       paste0(raw_time, "0"),
                       raw_time),

    # Step 1b: Pad to 6 digits (HHMMSS)
    raw_time = str_pad(raw_time, width = 6, pad = "0"),

    # Step 2: Convert to POSIXct (dummy date)
    base_time = as.POSIXct(
      str_replace(raw_time, "(\\d{2})(\\d{2})(\\d{2})", "\\1:\\2:\\3"),
      format = "%H:%M:%S",
      tz = "UTC"
    ),
    # Step 3: Add file offset and adjust CMBM times
    StartTime = format(
    base_time + as.numeric(`File Offset (s)`),
    "%H:%M:%S"
  )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    StartTime = if_else(
      Route.x == "CMBM",
      format(
        as.POSIXct(StartTime, format = "%H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC") - 3600,
        "%H:%M:%S"
      ),
      StartTime
    )
  ) %>%
  # Step 4: Remove specific problematic rows
  filter(
    !(ARU == "SMA06019COBO" & raw_time == "111030"),
    !(ARU == "SMA06024GRMW" & raw_time == "200538"),
    !(ARU == "SMA06018GRAS" & Year == 2023 & Survey == 1), # GRAS 2023 Survey 1, dropped due to incorrect recording times 
    !(ARU == "SMA06024GRMW" & Year == 2024 & Survey == 2), # GRMW-04 Survey 2 dropped due to dead batteries
    !(ARU == "S4A12908" & Year == 2023 & Survey == 1), # WLSE-04 Survey 1 off by 1 hour, dropped
    !(ARU == "SMA06018KSW3" & Year == 2024), # KASW-03 Survey 1 dropped due to technical issues and PC missing during survey 3, need to drop the entire point
    !(ARU == "SMA06001BIGM" & Year == 2022 & Survey == 3), # No recordings at BIGM 11 in 2022
    !(ARU == "SMA06000KSW2" & Year == 2024 & Survey == 3), # KASW-02 PC missing survey 3
    !(ARU == "S4A13179" & Year == 2023 & Survey == 1), #WLSW-04 PC missing survey 1
    !(ARU == "CHEBW2" & Year == 2023 & Survey == 1), #CHEB-02 PC missing survey 1
  )
  
###################################################### 
# 5. Clean up and reformat columns
######################################################

###################################################### 
# 5. Clean up extra data rows
###################################################### 
  
  # Only keep 1 row per species / ARU / day
  final_data_ordered2 <- final_data_ordered %>%  
    group_by(CommonName, Point, Date) %>%
      group_modify(~{
        data <- .
        
        # Try filtering to rows with IndivCount == 1
        verified <- data %>% filter(IndivCount == 1)
        
        if (nrow(verified) > 0) {
          # Keep the row with highest confidence among verified
          verified %>% slice_max(order_by = Confidence, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
        } else if (nrow(data) > 0) {
          # No verified rows, keep row with highest confidence overall
          data %>% slice_max(order_by = Confidence, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
        } else {
          # Just in case a group is somehow completely empty, return nothing
          tibble()
        }
      }) %>%
      ungroup() 

  # Clean up data where there are 16 instead of 15 total survey days
  
  # Function to drop one row from groups with >15 unique dates
  reduce_over15 <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Point, Year, CommonName) %>%
      group_modify(~{
        # Skip if group is already <= 15 rows
        if (nrow(.x) <= 15) return(.x)
  
        # Add internal row index for safe deletion
        .x$row_idx <- seq_len(nrow(.x))
  
        # Count rows per Survey
        survey_table <- table(.x$Survey)
        surveys_gt5 <- names(survey_table[survey_table > 5])
  
        # If no Survey has >5 rows, return as-is
        if (length(surveys_gt5) == 0) return(.x %>% select(-row_idx))
  
        # Filter to candidates
        candidates <- .x[.x$Survey %in% surveys_gt5, ]
  
        # Prioritize IndivCount == 0
        removable <- candidates[candidates$IndivCount == 0, ]
  
        if (nrow(removable) == 0) {
          removable <- candidates
        }
  
        # Pick one row index to remove
        idx_to_remove <- sample(removable$row_idx, 1)
  
        # Return data without that row
        .x <- .x[.x$row_idx != idx_to_remove, ]
        .x <- .x %>% select(-row_idx)
        return(.x)
      }) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

final_data_cleaned <- reduce_over15(final_data_ordered2)

# add up to 5 additional rows, if there are less than 5 rows, per Survey, CommonName, Point, and Year. Dates should be randomly assigned in character format (e.g., 2024-05-02) and must be between the following month and day, depending on the Survey and Geography, where:
  # Geography = North, Survey = 1 between 5/15 and 5/31, Survey = 2 between 6/01 and 6/14, Survey = 3 between 6/15 and 6/30
  # Geography = Central, Survey = 1 between 5/01 and 5/14, Survey = 2 between 5/15 and 5/31, Survey = 3 between 6/01 and 6/15
  # Geography = South, Survey = 1 between 4/15 and 4/30, Survey = 2 between 5/01 and 5/14, Survey = 3 between 5/15 and 5/31
# No dates can overlap

# StartTime should also be randomly assigned (currently in character format, e.g., 06:56:35) and must be between the minimum of 5:00 AM and maximum of 8:30 AM with the exception of Route == "CMBM" where the minimum time is 6:00 AM and maximum is 9:30 AM The associated CommonName, Point, and Year should be populated, and the IndivCount = 0.

# Need to note which sites had missing ARU SURVEYS! This is VERY IMPORTANT because you CAN'T ZERO FILL THESE ONES
# Review Surveys
final_data_ordered$IndivCount <- as.integer(final_data_ordered$IndivCount)
missing_survey_review <- final_data_ordered %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ARU, Year, Survey) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(Count = sum(IndivCount), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Survey, values_from = Count) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ARU, Year),
    names_to = "Missing_Survey",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(Count)) %>%
  select(-Count)

# Function to add rows as stated above
add_rows_if_needed4 <- function(df, missing_survey_review) {
  
  df$raw_time <- as.character(df$raw_time)
  df$Survey   <- as.character(df$Survey)
  
  date_ranges <- list(
    North = list("1" = c("05-15", "05-31"), "2" = c("06-01", "06-14"), "3" = c("06-15", "06-30")),
    Central = list("1" = c("05-01", "05-14"), "2" = c("05-15", "05-31"), "3" = c("06-01", "06-15")),
    South = list("1" = c("04-15", "04-30"), "2" = c("05-01", "05-14"), "3" = c("05-15", "05-31"))
  )
  
  get_random_times <- function() {
    
    min_sec <- 5 * 3600              # 05:00:00
    max_sec <- 8 * 3600 + 30 * 60    # 08:30:00
    
    rand_sec <- sample(min_sec:max_sec, 1)
    
    sprintf(
      "%02d:%02d:%02d",
      rand_sec %/% 3600,
      (rand_sec %% 3600) %/% 60,
      rand_sec %% 60
    )
  }
  
  get_date_pool <- function(geography, survey, year) {
    range <- date_ranges[[geography]][[as.character(survey)]]
    seq(
      lubridate::ymd(paste0(year, "-", range[1])),
      lubridate::ymd(paste0(year, "-", range[2])),
      by = "day"
    )
  }
  
  carry_cols <- c(
    "CommonName", "Point", "Year", "Geography", "Project", "Route", "Protocol",
    "BirdCd", "Scientific Name", "ARU", "Lat", "Long", "State"
  )
  
  final_rows <- list()
  group_keys <- df %>% distinct(CommonName, Point, Year)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(group_keys))) {
    
    grp <- group_keys[i, ]
    
    rows_grp <- df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        CommonName == grp$CommonName,
        Point == grp$Point,
        Year == grp$Year
      )
    
    ref_row   <- rows_grp[1, ]
    geography <- ref_row$Geography
    year      <- ref_row$Year
    point     <- ref_row$Point
    common    <- ref_row$CommonName
    
    used_dates <- unique(as.character(rows_grp$Date))
    
    all_survey_rows <- list()
    
    for (survey in c("1", "2", "3")) {
      
      existing_rows <- rows_grp %>% 
        dplyr::filter(Survey == survey)
      
      n_existing <- existing_rows$Date %>% 
        unique() %>% 
        length()
      
      if (any(
        missing_survey_review$ARU == ref_row$ARU &
          missing_survey_review$Year == year &
          missing_survey_review$Missing_Survey == survey,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )) {
        all_survey_rows[[survey]] <- existing_rows %>% 
          mutate(Added = "No")
        next
      }
      
      n_needed <- 5 - n_existing
      
      if (n_needed <= 0) {
        all_survey_rows[[survey]] <- existing_rows %>% 
          mutate(Added = "No")
        next
      }
      
      eligible_dates <- get_date_pool(geography, survey, year) %>%
        as.character() %>%
        setdiff(used_dates)
      
      if (length(eligible_dates) < n_needed) {
        warning(paste("Not enough unique dates for", common, point, year, "Survey", survey))
        all_survey_rows[[survey]] <- existing_rows %>% 
          mutate(Added = "No")
        next
      }
      
      new_dates <- sample(eligible_dates, n_needed)
      used_dates <- c(used_dates, new_dates)
      
      new_rows <- lapply(new_dates, function(d) {
        
        row <- tibble::tibble(
          Survey     = survey,
          CommonName = common,
          Point      = point,
          Year       = year,
          Date       = d,
          StartTime  = get_random_times(),
          IndivCount = 0,
          Added      = "Yes"
        )
        
        for (col in carry_cols) {
          row[[col]] <- ref_row[[col]]
        }
        
        row
      }) %>% 
        dplyr::bind_rows()
      
      all_survey_rows[[survey]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        existing_rows %>% mutate(Added = "No"),
        new_rows
      )
    }
    
    final_rows[[length(final_rows) + 1]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_survey_rows)
  }
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(final_rows)
}

# Run function
final_data_cleaned$IndivCount <- as.integer(final_data_cleaned$IndivCount)
final_zerofill_data <- add_rows_if_needed4(
  final_data_cleaned,
  missing_survey_review
)

# Remove weird rows with 16 observations that weren't already filtered
df_trimmed <- final_zerofill_data %>%

  dplyr::mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  filter(row_id <= 5) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-row_id) 
  
# Double check trimming
df_trimmed %>%
  group_by(CommonName, Point, Year) %>%
  tally() %>%
  filter(n == 15) 

# Double check number of point years (should be 60)
df_trimmed %>%
  select(Point, Year) %>%
  unique()

# Add index/visit 
df_trimmed_final <- df_trimmed %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Point, Year, CommonName) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(as.Date(Date), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Visit = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

write.csv(df_trimmed_final, "D:/Documents/Audubon/AGL/ARU/Validation/Verified/ARU_occupancy_zerofill_6_15_26.csv")

    # fix CMBM Route naming issue
    dplyr::mutate(Route = str_replace(Route, "^CMBM-[A-Za-z]+$", "CMBM")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Route = sub("-.*", "", Route)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Route = str_remove(Route, " .*")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Survey = Visit)

pcdata_raw$Year <- format(as.Date(pcdata_raw$Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"), "%Y")


# Filter to ARU points
pcdata <- pcdata_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate_at("Year", as.integer) %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(arudata, by = c("Point", "Year", "Survey")) %>%
  arrange(Year) 
colnames(pcdata)

arudata %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Point, Year) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(Visit = length(unique(Visit)))

pcdata %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Point, Year) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(Visit = length(unique(Visit)))

all_zerofill <- bind_rows(arudata, pcdata) %>%
  select(-X, -Scientific.Name) %>%
  mutate(Protocol = case_when(Protocol != "ARU" ~ "PC",
                              TRUE ~ Protocol))

write.csv(all_zerofill, "D:/Documents/Audubon/AGL/ARU/Validation/Verified/all_occ_zerofill_6_15_26.csv")

# CHECKING TIME ERRORS
df_trimmed_final <- read.csv("D:/Documents/Audubon/AGL/ARU/Validation/Verified/ARU_occupancy_zerofill_6_15_26.csv")

df_trimmed_final %>%

      min(as.POSIXct(StartTime, format = "%H:%M:%S"), na.rm = TRUE),
      "%H:%M:%S"
    ),
    max_time = format(
      max(as.POSIXct(StartTime, format = "%H:%M:%S"), na.rm = TRUE),
      "%H:%M:%S"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    duration = as_hms(max_time) - as_hms(min_time),

    flag_over_330 = duration_mins > 210
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Route))
